title: 购买汽车
problem_statement_md:
假设你有12,000美元用来买一辆车。
给定的程序，输入汽车的价格。

如果价格低于或等于12,000，则输出"buy"，否则不打印任何内容。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Conditional Statements[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You have $12,000 to buy a car.
You're given a program which takes the [b]price [/b]of car as an input.

[b]Task[/b]
Output [b]"yes"[/b] if the price is lower than or equal to 12,000.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
11000

[b]Sample Output[/b]
yes

[note]Use the [b]if[/b] statement to check the required condition.[/note]
hint_md: 使用**if**语句来检查所需条件。
